scope: Ela Maayan organic Instagram creative and measurement foundations
storage_policy: Git canonical; Notion mirror only under Ela Maayan Hub; no media/raw data in this ledger

maintenance.volatile_claims: Check before a dependent production decision and after material contradiction/UI/policy change.
maintenance.promotion_rule: Keep recommendations as hypotheses until relevant evidence justifies a scoped default.

sources.title: How AI Influences What You See on Facebook and Instagram
sources.supports: Multiple personalized ranking systems combine predictions and user feedback; sharing is one example, not the entire model.
sources.limitations: No complete 2026 weight table or post-specific causal explanation.
sources.revisit_trigger: Before using a precise current ranking claim; after a documented change.

sources.title: Instagram Ranking Explained
sources.supports: Dated surface distinctions: mixed Feed, connection-oriented Stories, Explore discovery and Reels entertainment/discovery.
sources.limitations: Original returned 429. Read historical original text republished by WebWire on 2023-06-01; do not call this live 2026 policy.
sources.revisit_trigger: Retrieve original or current platform cards before relying on a precise ranking mechanic.

sources.title: Instagram Feed Ranking System Card (historical)
sources.supports: Historical demonstration of candidate gathering, predictions, score combination and diversity rules.
sources.limitations: Explicit 2022 version; not a complete current description. Current Transparency Center cards were rate-limited.
sources.revisit_trigger: Replace historical specifics with a directly verified current card when accessible.

sources.title: Recommendation Guidelines announcement
sources.supports: Content can be allowed while being excluded from recommendation surfaces.
sources.limitations: Announcement is old; not an exhaustive current eligibility list.
sources.revisit_trigger: Check current policies/account notices before a present eligibility decision.

sources.title: Helping creators find new audiences (official Portuguese publication)
sources.supports: Meta announced originality changes, replacement of identical reposts and opportunities for smaller creators.
sources.limitations: Announcement is dated; exact rollout behavior, audience test size and thresholds are not verified as current.
sources.revisit_trigger: Recheck current original-content guidance before making eligibility assertions.

sources.title: 2026: AI Drives Performance
sources.supports: Meta reports more original posts in US Instagram recommendations during Q4 2025.
sources.limitations: US aggregate product metric does not forecast Israeli account reach or establish a creative effect.
sources.revisit_trigger: A new region-specific or platform update contradicts/changes the reported trend.

sources.title: The Anatomy of a Great Hook
sources.supports: Openings can combine text, image and audio and should promise content that actually pays off.
sources.limitations: Practitioner synthesis, not a randomized study or a guaranteed timing/word-count rule.
sources.revisit_trigger: Our own matched cases contradict the recommendation or the viewer situation changes.

sources.title: Mosseri original carousel Reel
sources.supports: Original locator for historically attributed second-item resurfacing and music eligibility statements.
sources.limitations: No readable original video in this run; no claim to have watched it. Conditional mechanics remain pending direct re-verification.
sources.revisit_trigger: Before asserting resurfacing/music eligibility as current; re-access the original or new official explanation.

sources.title: Colin and Samir with Adam Mosseri: Why Instagram Changed Its Mind on Long Form Video
sources.supports: Publisher confirms interview, publication date and topics including carousels and sends per reach.
sources.limitations: Metadata is not a checked transcript; no quoted ranking advice or universal priority order is established here.
sources.revisit_trigger: Read/listen to relevant original segment before detailed attribution.
sources.video_access_status: unreadable_shell; no listening or transcript inspection claimed

sources.title: State of Social Media Engagement 2026, detailed report
sources.supports: Provider-sample comparisons distinguish engagement per reach from reach and discuss format-dependent patterns.
sources.limitations: Multiple analysis windows; observational selection, topic and account confounding. No isolated causal format lift or Ela Maayan forecast.
sources.revisit_trigger: When using a numeric benchmark, re-read methodology and match period, numerator, denominator and population.

sources.title: State of Social Media Engagement 2026, companion landing page
sources.supports: The companion describes a 2024-2025 Buffer account sample and a follower-based engagement definition.
sources.limitations: Its denominator is not automatically interchangeable with the detailed Instagram engagement-per-reach table. Publication date was not extracted.
sources.revisit_trigger: Any comparison using its headline statistic; resolve definition/version mismatch first.

sources.title: Introducing Best Practices, an Education Hub for Creators on Instagram
sources.supports: Professional-dashboard education includes general and personalized guidance across creation, engagement, reach and policies.
sources.limitations: Does not establish which tips or features are available in a specific current account.
sources.revisit_trigger: Check the actual account dashboard before account-specific recommendations.

sources.title: New Ways to Create With Music and Collaborate With Friends on Instagram
sources.supports: Announced music support for photo carousels and collaboration capabilities.
sources.limitations: Not clearance for every track/use or verification of current collaborator limits, UI or Reels placement.
sources.revisit_trigger: Before selecting music, collaborators or publishing controls for a specific job.

sources.title: Access to the licensed music library on Instagram
sources.supports: Known Help destination for checking account/region/use restrictions.
sources.limitations: Readable content not retrieved; no claim that current detailed restrictions were verified.
sources.revisit_trigger: Before committing to music for a particular account, format or organic/paid use.

sources.title: Meta Music Guidelines
sources.supports: Known policy destination for planned music use.
sources.limitations: No readable policy text retrieved; this ledger does not provide track clearance or legal advice.
sources.revisit_trigger: Before music-dependent production or reuse.

sources.title: Introducing Edits: A Streamlined Video Creation App
sources.supports: Describes planning/editing, watermark-free export and distribution-related feedback such as skip rate; page includes later updates.
sources.limitations: No universal ranking advantage from using the app, and no guarantee every described feature is available in our account.
sources.revisit_trigger: Tool/interface change; before depending on a specific production or analytics feature.

sources.title: Visual Hierarchy in UX: Definition
sources.supports: Hierarchy can be established through scale, contrast and grouping to communicate intended importance.
sources.limitations: UX design guidance is not an isolated Instagram reach experiment. Publication date not extracted.
sources.revisit_trigger: If the actual phone-sized creative does not communicate the intended focus.

sources.title: Ensure High Contrast for Text Over Images
sources.supports: Text over imagery needs adequate contrast; image treatment can improve legibility.
sources.limitations: Reviewed 2026-01-13 according to source; no evidence for a specific brand color or engagement lift.
sources.revisit_trigger: Changing photo/video background, text placement or small-screen rendering.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)
sources.supports: Normal text benchmark 4.5:1 and large-text benchmark 3:1, with specified exceptions.
sources.limitations: A useful design benchmark; not proof of full compliance or a legal determination for a social post.
sources.revisit_trigger: New palette/layout or unclear contrast over changing footage.

sources.title: WAI Captions/Subtitles
sources.supports: Captions convey meaningful audio; need depends on the information communicated, not the mere presence of background music.
sources.limitations: Use-case guidance; check actual supported delivery and accuracy. No automatic Hebrew feature verification.
sources.revisit_trigger: When meaningful speech/sound is added or caption presentation changes.

sources.title: Recognizing Global Accessibility Awareness Day
sources.supports: Meta documented automatic captions for Instagram Feed videos at that time.
sources.limitations: The dated language list does not verify Hebrew, accuracy or a 2026 interface.
sources.revisit_trigger: Before relying on auto-caption availability; manually inspect captions.

sources.title: Using AI to Improve Photo Descriptions for People Who Are Blind and Visually Impaired
sources.supports: Meta describes alternative image descriptions and automatic recognition for people using assistive technology.
sources.limitations: Not proof a detailed infographic, named subject or on-image wording will be described accurately.
sources.revisit_trigger: When important visual information requires a text alternative; verify current controls.

sources.title: W3C Internationalization: Inline markup and bidirectional text in HTML
sources.supports: Mixed-direction phrases, punctuation and numerals can render incorrectly without directional handling.
sources.limitations: HTML techniques are not automatically usable in an image/video renderer; visual QA is still necessary.
sources.revisit_trigger: Mixed Hebrew/English/numbers or renderer/font changes.

sources.title: Test Content With Non-Followers Using Trial Reels
sources.supports: Trial Reels are designed to show work to non-followers before optional wider sharing.
sources.limitations: Not a randomized experiment or a guaranteed lift; check current availability and auto-sharing controls.
sources.revisit_trigger: Before planning a trial or making a publishing-setting change.

sources.title: Inspiring Creativity That Brings People Together, by Adam Mosseri
sources.supports: Later update describes broader Trial Reels availability and reports observational creator outcomes.
sources.limitations: Reported participants/results do not isolate the trial feature as the causal driver of growth.
sources.revisit_trigger: Before presenting trial availability or results as current/account-specific.

claims.claim: Treat ranking as surface-specific and personalized rather than a single universal formula.
claims.application: Choose a surface and viewer situation before a tactic.
claims.prohibited_inference: Exact 2026 signal weights or guaranteed reach.

claims.claim: Distinguish content permission from recommendation eligibility.
claims.application: Check account/content notices before diagnosing poor creative.
claims.prohibited_inference: Every allowed post will be recommended.

claims.claim: Prioritize our own meaningful contribution and verify borrowed material separately.
claims.application: Use original footage, real product demos and distinctive explanation.
claims.prohibited_inference: A reused template is automatically unoriginal or credit alone clears rights.

claims.claim: Opening promise and actual payoff should agree.
claims.application: Generate relevant hook options, avoid bait and deliver early value.
claims.prohibited_inference: Exact hook timing/word count guarantees performance.

claims.claim: Carousel slide 2 should be understandable alone while advancing the original sequence.
claims.prohibited_inference: Every viewer gets two carousel impressions.

claims.claim: Carousel second-item resurfacing is conditional historically attributed guidance, pending direct refresh.
claims.application: Use may/conditional wording if discussing inherited guidance; do not assert new current mechanics.
claims.prohibited_inference: Every carousel is shown exactly twice.

claims.claim: Photo carousels support music; a music-in-Reels placement claim requires separate current verification.
claims.application: Choose music by fit, availability and rights, not an automatic boost claim.
claims.prohibited_inference: Music guarantees distribution or is cleared for any business use.

claims.claim: Format comparisons depend on the metric, sample and data window.
claims.application: Use broad studies as hypotheses and compare similar own posts.
claims.prohibited_inference: Carousels universally outperform Reels; combine incompatible denominators.

claims.claim: Use a sustainable cadence and account-specific guidance rather than a universal posting quota.
claims.application: Protect the chosen content job and production quality while testing a cadence.
claims.prohibited_inference: Observed frequent publishers prove a causal mandatory volume threshold.

claims.claim: Music-specific account, placement, region and reuse checks remain a production dependency.
claims.application: Verify actual availability and intended use before relying on a track.
claims.prohibited_inference: A track visible in an editor is cleared for every future use.

claims.claim: Use editing tools for clear planning, proof and useful feedback.
claims.application: Storyboard product demonstrations; review available skip/watch feedback.
claims.prohibited_inference: Editing in a named app receives an undocumented ranking bonus.

claims.claim: Create a readable hierarchy and adequate contrast over the actual image or moving background.
claims.application: Inspect at phone size and across representative video frames.
claims.prohibited_inference: One color or contrast score predicts Instagram reach or establishes full accessibility compliance.

claims.claim: Make meaningful speech and sound understandable through accurate supported captions/text.
claims.application: Review names, numerals, speakers and sound cues manually.
claims.prohibited_inference: Old auto-caption announcements prove Hebrew support or perfect accuracy now.

claims.claim: Provide meaningful text alternatives for important image information when supported.
claims.application: Describe relevant subject and essential information; do not trust automatic descriptions blindly.
claims.prohibited_inference: Automatic alt text necessarily reads every infographic label.

claims.claim: Mixed Hebrew/English, punctuation and numerals need renderer-aware bidi handling and visual QA.
claims.application: Inspect actual exports rather than assuming centered text is correct RTL.
claims.prohibited_inference: An HTML solution automatically fixes every raster/video tool.

claims.claim: Trial Reels can support exploration but do not create a randomized A/B test.
claims.application: Check availability and settings; compare fixed-age outcomes with a matched baseline.
claims.prohibited_inference: Guaranteed uplift or silent authorization to publish/auto-share.

claims.claim: Choose one primary intended outcome but allow no CTA.
claims.application: A story, humor or scenic moment can be complete without an install/sales request.
claims.prohibited_inference: A funnel framework overrides the actual brief.

claims.claim: Keep shares distinct from DM sends, views from reach, raw counts from unique people, and average watch time from completion.
claims.application: Read provider definitions and compare same-age matched populations.
claims.prohibited_inference: Fill unavailable private metrics from public visible counts.

unresolved_access.consequence: No current detailed predictions/weights quoted from these cards.
Reported 2026 expansion to photos/carousels is not promoted to verified current policy.

unresolved_access.topic: September 2026 Mosseri ranking series and October clip
unresolved_access.consequence: Located using secondary research; exact spoken guidance not adopted as a verified formula.
Hebrew auto-captions, music/editor controls, current limits and account features need real-interface confirmation.
